title: VAT Compliance Certification for Industrial Imports
summary: The concept of 'tax returns' evolved from a simple requirement for proof of filing to a standardized 'VAT compliant' status definition for industrial importers. Over time, the documentation shifted from manual verification to specific definitions of 'VAT compliant' entities, requiring regular submission of returns as a prerequisite for duty concessions.

evolution.definition: Shifted from a generic mention of '12 returns' to a legally defined 'VAT compliant' status.
evolution.procedure: Transitioned from manual certification to a standardized regulatory requirement for industrial importers.

timeline.change: Initial requirement for submission of 12 VAT returns to qualify for concessional duty rates.
Formalized the definition of 'VAT compliant' as an entity registered under the 2012 Act that regularly submits returns.
Standardized the 'VAT compliant' definition across different manufacturing sectors (AC, ATM, Camera).
Extended the standardized 'VAT compliant' definition to mould/die manufacturing.
Applied the 'VAT compliant' return filing requirement to generator manufacturing/assembling.

সিল:

Value Added Tax: The document requires a certification confirming that an importer operating an amusement park is registered for Value Added Tax purposes.
The certification confirms whether the entity maintains compliance by regularly paying tax and submitting tax returns.
Customs, Excise and VAT Department: The departmental officer is responsible for certifying the tax registration and compliance status of businesses under their jurisdiction.
The certification must confirm that the registered business has no outstanding tax arrears owed to this department.
